agent.description: Path to the drafting agent's agent.yaml, relative to workflow.yaml. Produces only the advisory fields in ai_may_draft.
agent.title: Agent

EdgeNode.description:
A leaf node that runs an agent and emits a gate-validated input object.

Edge nodes never emit a verdict and never declare a decision table; the
closed schema (no ``decision``/``hit_policy``/``inputs`` fields) is what
keeps AI output off the spine (FR-005).

id.description: Unique node id within the workflow.
id.title: Id

edge.description: The agent that produces this node's object.

gate.description: The schema gate the agent output must cross.

source.description: Optional authority annotation (knowledgeSource-lite), e.g. "Hardship Policy v4.2 §72"; recorded and emitted as a span attribute.
source.title: Source

EdgeNode.title: EdgeNode

EdgeRef.description: The agent reference on an edge node (``edge: {agent: ...}``).

agent.description: Path to the edge agent's agent.yaml, relative to workflow.yaml.
agent.title: Agent

EdgeRef.title: EdgeRef

GateRef.description:
The schema gate on an edge node (``gate: {schema: ...}``).

The gate's JSON Schema is the typed boundary the agent's structured output
must satisfy before it may cross into the spine (FR-007).

schema.description: Path to the gate JSON Schema, relative to workflow.yaml. The edge agent's structured_output is validated against it at the gate.
schema.title: Schema

GateRef.title: GateRef

HumanNode.description:
The bright line: a DMN table recommends, a named human decides.

The table is evaluated to produce a *recommendation* (refinements §2); the
CLI prompts a human to accept or override it. AI output may only draft the
advisory fields named in ``ai_may_draft`` — never the verdict (FR-015a).

id.description: Unique node id within the workflow.
id.title: Id

decision.description: Path to the decision table (tables/*.dmn.yaml), relative to workflow.yaml.
decision.title: Decision

inputs.description: Ids of the nodes whose verdicts/objects feed this table.
inputs.title: Inputs

requires_human.description: Marks this node as the human determination (always true).
requires_human.title: Requires Human

decided_by.description: Declared decision-maker role or name (refinements §6); confirmed or entered at the CLI prompt and recorded verbatim.
decided_by.title: Decided By

draft.description: Optional drafting agent; produces only ai_may_draft fields.

ai_may_draft.description: Advisory fields the drafting agent may produce (POC: [reasons]). Never populates the verdict.
ai_may_draft.title: Ai May Draft

HumanNode.title: HumanNode

PolicyNode.description:
A pure determination node: a DMN table evaluated over named inputs.

The hit policy is a property of the referenced decision table (DMN-faithful,
single source of truth), not of the node — see ``DecisionTable.hit_policy``.

id.description: Unique node id within the workflow.
id.title: Id

decision.description: Path to the decision table (tables/*.dmn.yaml), relative to workflow.yaml.
decision.title: Decision

inputs.description: Ids of the nodes whose verdicts/objects feed this table.
inputs.title: Inputs

PolicyNode.title: PolicyNode

description:
The ``workflow.yaml`` artifact: a DAG of determination nodes.

The graph is the DMN Decision Requirement Diagram in logical form: a node's
``inputs`` name the nodes below it. The graph must be acyclic with all
references resolved — both are enforced at load, before any agent runs
(FR-003).

nodes.description: The workflow's determination and edge nodes.
nodes.title: Nodes

title: Workflow
